name: @jgphilpott/polytree
description: A Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) library using Octree data structure.

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:node && npm run build:browser && npm run minify
scripts.build:node: cat app/imports.js app/polytree.js app/csg/unite.js app/csg/subtract.js app/csg/intersect.js app/triangles.js app/exports.js > polytree.bundle.js
scripts.minify: uglifyjs polytree.bundle.js --compress --mangle -o polytree.bundle.min.js && uglifyjs polytree.bundle.browser.js --compress --mangle -o polytree.bundle.browser.min.js
